# AliceLabs Energy — LLM Documentation

> AliceLabs is a commercial energy procurement platform. We run real-time auctions where 12+ certified energy suppliers (Constellation, Direct Energy, Vistra, NRG, ENGIE, Calpine and others) compete for your commercial electricity and natural gas contract. Typical savings: 25-40% below utility default supply rates.

## MCP Server (for AI agents)

AliceLabs exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with 3 production-ready tools:

- **get_energy_quotes** — Submit a commercial utility bill, get real-time supplier bids
- **check_eligibility** — Validate if a business qualifies for deregulated energy auctions
- **get_market_rates** — Default utility rate vs competitive auction-clearing rate by state

**Endpoint**: https://alicelabs.energy/mcp/alicelabs-energy
**Docs**: https://alicelabs.energy/mcp/alicelabs-energy
**MarketNow**: https://marketnow.site/mcp/alicelabs-energy

## What we do

AliceLabs LLC is an authorized affiliate of Bid On Energy — a licensed commercial energy broker operating in all 12+ deregulated US states. We connect businesses to competitive energy procurement tools that were previously reserved for large enterprises.

## Coverage

| State | Electricity | Natural Gas |
|---|---|---|
| Texas (TX) | ERCOT, SPP | Yes (Gas Choice) |
| New York (NY) | NYISO | Yes |
| Pennsylvania (PA) | PJM | Yes |
| Ohio (OH) | PJM, MISO | Yes |
| New Jersey (NJ) | PJM | Yes |
| Illinois (IL) | MISO, PJM | Yes |
| Maryland (MD) | PJM | Yes |
| Massachusetts (MA) | ISO-NE | Yes |
| Connecticut (CT) | ISO-NE | No |
| Maine (ME) | ISO-NE | No |
| New Hampshire (NH) | ISO-NE | No |
| Rhode Island (RI) | ISO-NE | No |
| Delaware (DE) | PJM | No |
| Washington DC | PJM | No |
| Canada | Multi-province | Yes |

## Tools exposed via MCP

### 1. get_energy_quotes

Submit a commercial utility bill to the Bid On Energy auction platform.

**Parameters**:
- company_name (required, string)
- contact_name (required, string)
- email (required, string)
- phone (required, string)
- monthly_utility_spend (required, number)
- fuel_type (optional, enum: "Electric" | "Gas" | "Both", default: "Both")
- zip_code (optional, string)
- state (optional, string — 2-letter US state code)
- agent_id (optional, string — for affiliate revenue attribution)

**Returns**: quote_id, eligible, estimated_savings_pct, estimated_monthly_savings, suppliers_competing, supplier_list, auction_status, next_steps

### 2. check_eligibility

Validate whether a business qualifies for competitive energy auctions.

**Parameters**:
- state (required, string — 2-letter US state code)
- zip_code (optional, string)
- monthly_utility_spend (optional, number)
- fuel_type (optional, enum, default: "Both")

**Returns**: eligible, state_name, markets, gas_choice_available, savings estimate

### 3. get_market_rates

Returns default utility rate vs competitive auction-clearing rate by state.

**Parameters**:
- state (required, string — 2-letter US state code)
- fuel_type (optional, enum, default: "Electric")
- zip_code (optional, string)

**Returns**: utility_default_rate, auction_clearing_rate, savings_pct, monthly_savings_estimate, annual_savings_estimate

## Use cases for AI agents

| Vertical AI Agent | How they use AliceLabs MCP |
|---|---|
| **CFO Copilots** (Brex AI, Rippling, Ramp) | `get_market_rates` for quarterly cost-reduction audits |
| **Procurement Copilots** (Zip AI, Tropic) | `check_eligibility` + `get_energy_quotes` for new client onboardings |
| **Facility Management AI** (Siemens, JCI) | Portfolio rebids + market rate benchmarking |
| **Real Estate AI** (VTS, HqO) | Multi-property eligibility + aggregated auctions |
| **Manufacturing ERP AI** | Embedded energy procurement via `get_energy_quotes` |

## Affiliate program for agents

Agents that submit leads via `get_energy_quotes` with their `agent_id` earn commission:
- Electricity: $0.005/kWh of contracted volume (~$500-$2,500 per closed deal)
- Natural gas: $0.05/therm of contracted volume (~$250-$1,500 per closed deal)
- Multi-year contracts: +20% bonus

Register at https://alicelabs.energy/agents

## Quick start

Install MCP server in Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cline / Continue.dev:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "alicelabs-energy": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@alicelabs/energy-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Or via HTTP transport:
```bash
curl -X POST https://alicelabs.energy/mcp/alicelabs-energy \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool": "get_market_rates", "args": {"state": "TX", "fuel_type": "Electric"}}'
```
